answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Each submission hangs on the tide of a task receipt, and the shale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
